question.knowledge_point: Finding the General Solution of a Singular 3x3 System of Equations with Two Pivots
question.problem:
Consider the system

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{3}=-2 \\ -2{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}+4{x}_{3}=2 \\ 3{x}_{1}-6{x}_{3}=-6.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 & 2 \\ 3 & 0 & -6 & -6\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ -2 & 1 & 4 & 2 \\ 3 & 0 & -6 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 3 & 0 & -6 & -6\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & -2 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
